direction: separate repository-local installability from real Provider, release trust, security and native-device gates
detail: PM, chief architect and Agent-boundary auditor were dispatched before the first implementation package.

direction: join the verified official OpenCode launcher to the existing Relay and Web chain through an explicit stock adapter boundary
detail: Prebuilt foundation froze; PM acceptance and architecture DAG froze; public API containment passed full Cargo tests and entered independent audit; stock envelope implementation was reassigned after a zero-delta stall.

direction: bundle the exact verified Darwin Agent binary, pass Provider bytes over an anonymous FD, and introduce a crate-private Host-final command authority before opening Gateway writes
detail: Official OpenCode 1.18.16 materializes and starts from the prebuilt bundle; launcher has a three-process official-agent-local mode with explicit projector/command/identity blockers; stock envelope and public API boundaries are frozen; Host authority tests and audit are in progress.

direction: freeze content-safe official snapshots, Host-final crash semantics and public command DTOs before introducing a run-owned Host process and Unix-domain projector transport
detail: Snapshot, Host authority and public reply/deny/stop contracts passed independent audits after security rework. C1 now creates an exact run-owned official session and bootstraps a long-lived Rust Host over an anonymous FD; ambient proxy leakage and lifecycle gaps were found and fixed, with final independent re-audit pending.

direction: replace the fixed-key local Alpha delivery path with a run-owned Rust Host projector and private Unix-domain Gateway channel
detail: Public commands, official snapshot projection, Host authority foundation and same-run Host bootstrap are independently frozen. The next gate is an exact-session continuous projector over a private UDS; remote identity and Provider-backed evidence remain separate gates.

direction: freeze the independently audited C2 read path, keep E3 explicitly not run, and dispatch the minimum Host-final reply deny Stop DAG
detail: Frozen-disk Rust, Mobile, Gateway, launcher and Relay gates passed; the fresh delta audit closed all prior C2 P1 findings. The stale continuous-projector blocker was removed while secure command authority and production device identity remain blocked. PM and architecture contracts now separate C3 code freeze from two-run Provider-backed acceptance.

direction: freeze the local safe command chain after independent audit, then replace hardcoded local device identity and test-only pairing with a real revocable remote-device authority
detail: All current-disk static and focused gates passed. Two visible-control mechanical E2 runs support C3 CODE_FROZEN only. Provider E3 is blocked because no allowlisted credential variable is present. PM separated five product gates; current-state audit found the official launcher remains local-only, Relay pairing is test-only and Product Host hardcodes local-gateway-device.

direction: establish a persistent revocable single-device authority before adding any remote transport route
detail: The first contract audit blocked raw-challenge reconstruction, rollback expiry and revoke/claim linearization. The contract and A1 module were reworked; 13 focused tests, full Rust targets and clippy passed, and a fresh independent audit returned PASS/FREEZE. A2 must now wire the registry through one shared mutation/command lock without conflating local FD11 trust with a paired phone.

direction: adopt the persistent registry behind authenticated local Host administration while preserving the frozen local command principal
detail: A2a added a stable persistent registry path, safe lifecycle, four FD11-authenticated management routes and fixed Host principal ownership without exposing remote command ingress. Rust 234 tests, clippy and launcher 55 tests passed. Two fresh visible-control mechanical E2 runs passed after harness bootstrap adaptation; one intervening CDP response-body race was not counted. Independent A2a audit returned PASS/FREEZE.

direction: replace validation-only Relay semantics with a disjoint opaque v2 mailbox before any Host or browser remote join
detail: A reuse audit proved v1 registration, read auth, Ed25519 envelope and WebSocket are not production boundaries. The v2 contract was tightened for role matrix, ACK cursors, durable replay, TLS termination and irreversible revoke. Protocol/store and HTTP surfaces passed two independent audits after provisioning no-follow and graceful-shutdown fixes; go test, race and vet passed.

direction: prove endpoint-only cross-language encryption before joining Host, Relay and browser state
detail: WebCrypto and Rust codecs agree on P-256 ECDH, HKDF, AES-GCM, deterministic nonces, canonical AAD, padding and P1363 signature verification. Web self-tests passed 7/7, Rust 4/4, shared TEST_ONLY_VECTOR decrypts in both directions, TypeScript build and Rust clippy pass. This is codec evidence only, not remote-product evidence.
